description: Shows the team's active add-ons, scale packs and video licences with status, renewal date and usage. Use when the user asks which add-ons or packs they have, when they renew, or how many licensed videos or wearable users they use. Not for plan limits (use get_team_usage) or buying add-ons (done in Teams). Returns status and usage only, no prices.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_addons_status
title: Get add-on status
